messages:
elaine (People Ops): Quick update: were opening a temporary 'late intake' queue for performance forms that missed the main deadline due to approved LOA or emergencies. Read steps below and RT if you own approvals.

raj (HRBP): What's the cutoff for this queue? same-week only?

elaine (People Ops): Cutoff: submissions received by end-of-week (Fri 11:59pm PT). Managers then have 72 hours to complete the approval checkbox in the master tracker.

tom (Eng Manager): If a report submitted late because of a shifted timezone, should I add any special note?

elaine (People Ops): Please add a short reason in the "late-reason" column (timezone/health/LOA). That helps audit and calibration.

zoe (People Ops): I'll run a dedupe + import at 1pm. Steps: export -> validate -> hris append. If you want to pre-check, filter the tracker for "late-intake".

import-bot: Form received: tom@redwood  1 submission (auto)

raj (HRBP): Escalation question: if manager doesn't approve in 72h, route to their manager + cc HRBP?

elaine (People Ops): Yes  escalate to managers manager and cc HRBP after 72h. Also ping People Ops if any case affects comp or offer windows.

tom (Eng Manager): Marking approvals and adding notes now. Thanks.

zoe (People Ops): Import complete: 3 rows appended, 1 duplicate skipped. Posting a short summary to the tracker. :white_check_mark:
